headline: Nola and Schwarber's two homers shut out Houston
recap: The Phillies beat the Astros 3-0 in Houston. Kyle Schwarber homered to left center in the top of the first for a 1-0 lead, and the score stayed there until the eighth, when Bryson Stott homered to right field and Schwarber followed with a second home run, his 46th of the season, to right.

Aaron Nola started and allowed two hits over 6.2 scoreless innings with no walks and nine strikeouts on 88 pitches, earning the win. Lance McCullers Jr. went six innings for the Astros, allowing six hits and one run, and took the loss.

José Alvarado followed Nola and struck out three over 1.1 hitless innings, and Zach Eflin pitched the ninth for the save. Stott went 3 for 3 with a walk, a home run and an RBI, and Schwarber finished 2 for 3 with two walks, two homers and two RBI. Houston had two hits.
